State the purpose and scope of the risk assessment in one paragraph.
Name the system, the assessment period, and the standards applied
(e.g., ISO 31000, JSP 940).

# Asset inventory

List the assets within scope. For each asset, state its classification,
its value, and the owner.

| Asset | Classification | Value | Owner |
|-------|----------------|-------|-------|
| User database | OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE | High | Data Controller |
| Search index | OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE | High | System Owner |
| API gateway | OFFICIAL | Medium | Platform Owner |

# Threat catalogue (STRIDE)

Apply the STRIDE threat model to each asset. For each threat, state
the likelihood and impact.

## Spoofing

What threats allow an attacker to impersonate a legitimate user or
component?

| Threat | Asset | Likelihood | Impact |
|--------|-------|------------|--------|
| Credential theft | User database | Medium | High |
| API key compromise | API gateway | Low | High |

## Tampering

What threats allow an attacker to modify data or code?

| Threat | Asset | Likelihood | Impact |
|--------|-------|------------|--------|
| SQL injection | User database | Low | Critical |
| Man-in-the-middle | API gateway | Low | High |

## Repudiation

What threats allow a user to deny an action?

| Threat | Asset | Likelihood | Impact |
|--------|-------|------------|--------|
| Audit log tampering | User database | Low | High |

## Information disclosure

What threats allow an attacker to access sensitive data?

| Threat | Asset | Likelihood | Impact |
|--------|-------|------------|--------|
| Data exfiltration | Search index | Medium | Critical |
| Unauthorized query | API gateway | Medium | High |

## Denial of service

What threats allow an attacker to disrupt availability?

| Threat | Asset | Likelihood | Impact |
|--------|-------|------------|--------|
| Volumetric attack | API gateway | High | Medium |
| Resource exhaustion | Search index | Medium | High |

## Elevation of privilege

What threats allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access?

| Threat | Asset | Likelihood | Impact |
|--------|-------|------------|--------|
| Privilege escalation | User database | Low | Critical |
| Container escape | API gateway | Low | Critical |

# Risk matrix

Map each risk to the matrix. The rating is likelihood multiplied
by impact.

| Likelihood \ Impact | Low | Medium | High | Critical |
|---------------------|-----|--------|------|----------|
| High | Medium | High | Critical | Critical |
| Medium | Low | Medium | High | Critical |
| Low | Low | Low | Medium | High |

# Risk register

For each identified risk, state the rating, the mitigation, and
the residual risk.

| Risk | Rating | Mitigation | Owner | Residual |
|------|--------|------------|-------|----------|
| Credential theft | High | MFA + rotation | Security Lead | Medium |
| SQL injection | Critical | Parameterized queries + WAF | Dev Lead | Low |
| Data exfiltration | Critical | Encryption + DLP | Data Controller | Medium |
| Volumetric attack | High | CDN + rate limiting | Platform Owner | Medium |

# Acceptance criteria

State the risk appetite. Which risks are accepted, which require
mitigation, and which are unacceptable?

# Appendices

State any supplementary material: assumptions, glossary, or
references.
